spec.Business source and objective: BRD ch09; Track markets, demand, competitors, industry signals and geographic expansion opportunities

wb.Business objective: Track markets, demand, competitors, industry signals and geographic expansion opportunities
wb.Detailed functionality: Retrieve allowed signals; classify demand; compare freshness; cite evidence
wb.Applicable industries: All authorized sectors; B2B, D2C and institutional market research
wb.Trigger types: Scheduled or manual; scoped event on change
wb.Workflow steps: Retrieve allowed signals; classify demand; compare freshness; cite evidence
wb.Prerequisite automations: Included foundation; no mandatory upstream paid service; optional input producers: None; authorized equivalent input accepted.
wb.Automation operating mode: AI-assisted / supervised; controlled autonomous only for preapproved eligible routine steps; simulation has zero external effects.
wb.Human approval requirements: Approve source rights and material claims; no restricted scraping
wb.Related API operations: GET /api/v1/sources; GET /api/v1/research/plans; POST /api/v1/research/plans; GET /api/v1/research/results; GET /api/v1/research/runs/{id}; ADAPTER Public web search; GET /api/v1/market/competitors; POST /api/v1/admin/competitor-sources
wb.Related database entities: growth_source; growth_source_policy; growth_source_record; growth_evidence; growth_competitor; growth_market_event
wb.Open-source software requirements: Python; Django REST Framework; PostgreSQL; Celery / Beat; Valkey; pgvector if needed; approved extraction libraries
wb.External provider requirements: Authorized market data/search APIs or client documents
wb.Estimated execution cost: Illustrative internal text/compute scenario: Cost Model SM-SVC-01-WF01; full execution cost TBD incl. external fees/human/retries.
wb.Subscription pricing model: Proposed monthly base entitlement + metered excess per market research batch; annual option; provider charges/managed service separately quoted. Price TBD.
wb.Usage limits: Illustrative pilot: 100 market research batch(s)/month; 1 concurrent run; configurable hard budget, provider quota and frequency limits. Not approved.
wb.Full / partial / selective availability: Full suite / Research & Lead Intelligence bundle / selective (1 SKU); entitlement and usage approval required.
wb.Security and compliance requirements: Tenant + startup scope; capability and entitlement checks per action; minimum data access; audit; budget reservation; idempotency; suppression where applicable. Commercial only; comply with channel, data and advertising permissions; no private fundraising.
wb.Performance KPIs: Evidence-linked findings ≥95%; stale-source flags 100%
wb.Acceptance test references: SM-SVC-01-WF01-AT01; related UI: A015; A016; A085; A086
wb.Implementation and verification status: Proposed; test Not run; live execution and pricing pending.
wb.Independent purchase justification: Standalone outcome: Market and demand monitoring; client may supply equivalent authorized inputs rather than buy upstream services.
wb.Measurable customer outcome: Market signals and alerts; accepted against KPI and evidence, not a guaranteed business outcome.
wb.Shared execution engine: Research and evidence; Workflow orchestration; Governance
wb.Required service entitlements: SM-SVC-01 + foundation; tenant/startup, capability, role, channel/provider and budget checks at every action
wb.Agent identity and authority: Scoped service principal or authorized delegated user; deny privilege escalation; short-lived grants; no shared credentials
wb.External agent interoperability: Optional authorized connector; external agent access disabled unless explicitly granted
wb.Model portability: Provider-neutral model adapter; rules-first; quality/cost gate; no vendor lock-in assumed
wb.Event and trigger schema: Proposed event envelope: event_id, tenant_id, startup_id, service_id, workflow_revision, input_ref, occurred_at, correlation_id; validate schema and reject mismatched scope
wb.External side-effect classification: Internal analysis/draft; no external action without separate authorization
wb.Idempotency and conflict policy: Idempotency key = scoped event + workflow revision + action target; check duplicate side effects, conflicts, active reply/suppression and budget reservation
wb.Escalation and recovery policy: Bounded retry for safe failures; reconcile uncertain external outcome before retry; pause, route reviewer and log; emergency stop
wb.Data provenance requirements: Authorized source ID, owner, scope, observed_at, evidence hash/version, permitted use, freshness; hold stale/conflicting evidence
wb.Simulation and benchmark reference: SM-SVC-01-WF01-AT01; synthetic dry run and measured benchmark pending
wb.Unit economics and margin target: Unit economics pending actual provider/labor/retry costs; quote subscription + usage; margin target TBD by owner
wb.Technology and regulatory readiness: Proposed; test and validate customer demand, provider access and economics
wb.Service migration and deprecation policy: Stable IDs; version and review material changes; immutable active-run snapshot; no silent downgrade; notify subscribers and map entitlements before migration

wb_at.Preconditions: Active entitlement, correct tenant/startup, valid inputs and approved policy; provider stub/synthetic fixtures
wb_at.Execution steps: Retrieve allowed signals; classify demand; compare freshness; cite evidence
wb_at.Negative and boundary checks: Repeat event; attempt wrong tenant, revoked entitlement, invalid input or exhausted budget; reject or hold without unauthorized side effects.
wb_at.Approval checks: Approve source rights and material claims; no restricted scraping
wb_at.Target KPI: Evidence-linked findings ≥95%; stale-source flags 100%

wb_cost.Unit: 1 workflow invocation; not a full service cycle
wb_cost.Exclusions: One attempt; retry, larger inputs and human labor excluded

wb.Sub-automation name: SM-SVC-20-WF04 — Order fulfillment prediction and exception monitoring
wb.Business objective: Coordinate approved sales orders, customer delivery milestones and fulfillment handoffs; procurement moved to SM-SVC-39.
wb.Detailed functionality: Estimate delay risk; compare actual milestone; alert owner; escalate exceptions
wb.Applicable industries: Manufacturing, distribution, retail, agriculture, services and procurement
wb.Trigger types: Manual; scheduled or relevant validated business event; provider webhook only where authorized
wb.Required input data: Sales order, delivery events, capacity and promised dates
wb.Workflow steps: Estimate delay risk; compare actual milestone; alert owner; escalate exceptions
wb.Prerequisite automations: Included foundation; no mandatory upstream paid service; optional input producers: SM-SVC-17; SM-SVC-18; authorized equivalent input accepted.
wb.Automation operating mode: AI-assisted / supervised; controlled autonomous only for preapproved eligible routine steps; simulation has zero external effects.
wb.Human approval requirements: Approve source/data rights and applicable external actions; approve consequential communications, commitments and changes; routine steps only within preapproved policies.
wb.Related API operations: GET /api/v1/sales/orders; POST /api/v1/sales/orders; PATCH /api/v1/sales/orders/{id}; GET /api/v1/quotes; POST /api/v1/quotes; GET /api/v1/onboarding; POST /api/v1/onboarding/{id}/complete; GET /api/v1/partners; POST /api/v1/partners
wb.Related database entities: growth_approval; growth_deal; growth_invoice; growth_payment; growth_quote; sales_fulfillment; sales_order; sales_order_line; growth_quote_line
wb.Open-source software requirements: Python; Django REST Framework; PostgreSQL; Celery / Beat; Valkey
wb.External provider requirements: Client inventory/ERP data or manual import; authorized order connector if available
wb.Estimated execution cost: Illustrative internal text/compute scenario: Cost Model SM-SVC-20-WF04; full execution cost TBD incl. external fees/human/retries.
wb.Subscription pricing model: Proposed monthly base entitlement + metered excess per order case; annual option; provider charges/managed service separately quoted. Price TBD.
wb.Usage limits: Illustrative pilot: 200 order case(s)/month; 1 concurrent run; configurable hard budget, provider quota and frequency limits. Not approved.
wb.Full / partial / selective availability: Full suite / Sales Conversion & Operations bundle / selective (1 SKU); entitlement and usage approval required.
wb.Security and compliance requirements: Tenant + startup scope; capability and entitlement checks per action; minimum data access; audit; budget reservation; idempotency; suppression where applicable. Commercial only; comply with channel, data and advertising permissions; no private fundraising.
wb.Performance KPIs: Order arithmetic pass 100%; duplicate commitments = 0
wb.Acceptance test references: SM-SVC-20-WF04-AT01; related UI: A105; A067; A075; A077
wb.Implementation and verification status: Proposed; test Not run; live execution and pricing pending.
wb.Independent purchase justification: Standalone outcome: Order fulfillment prediction and exception monitoring; client may supply equivalent authorized inputs rather than buy upstream services.
wb.Measurable customer outcome: Fulfillment forecast and exception queue; accepted against KPI and evidence, not a guaranteed business outcome.
wb.Required service entitlements: SM-SVC-20 + foundation; tenant/startup, capability, role, channel/provider and budget checks at every action
wb.Agent identity and authority: Scoped service principal or authorized delegated user; deny privilege escalation; short-lived grants; no shared credentials
wb.External agent interoperability: Optional authorized connector; external agent access disabled unless explicitly granted
wb.Model portability: Provider-neutral model adapter; rules-first; quality/cost gate; no vendor lock-in assumed
wb.Event and trigger schema: Proposed event envelope: event_id, tenant_id, startup_id, service_id, workflow_revision, input_ref, occurred_at, correlation_id; validate schema and reject mismatched scope
wb.External side-effect classification: Internal analysis/draft; no external action without separate authorization
wb.Idempotency and conflict policy: Idempotency key = scoped event + workflow revision + action target; check duplicate side effects, conflicts, active reply/suppression and budget reservation
wb.Escalation and recovery policy: Bounded retry for safe failures; reconcile uncertain external outcome before retry; pause, route reviewer and log; emergency stop
wb.Data provenance requirements: Authorized source ID, owner, scope, observed_at, evidence hash/version, permitted use, freshness; hold stale/conflicting evidence
wb.Simulation and benchmark reference: SM-SVC-20-WF04-AT01; synthetic dry run and measured benchmark pending
wb.Unit economics and margin target: Unit economics pending actual provider/labor/retry costs; quote subscription + usage; margin target TBD by owner
wb.Technology and regulatory readiness: Proposed; test and validate customer demand, provider access and economics
wb.Service migration and deprecation policy: Stable IDs; version and review material changes; immutable active-run snapshot; no silent downgrade; notify subscribers and map entitlements before migration
